name: Simple Page Folder Organizer
author: Come2theweb

sections.description:
Simple Page Folder Organizer is a simple and effective way to organize WordPress backend pages into folders for easy filtering and management. This is a completely FREE plugin designed to help users like you organize pages without unnecessary complexity. It allows you to easily create folders and categorize your pages for better organization and filtering — no more complicated plugins with unnecessary options. Just the basics, done right. The plugin creates a simple taxonomy system for your pages, allowing you to:

  • Create unlimited folders/categories for your pages
  • Filter pages by folder in the admin list
  • Maintain hierarchical folder structure (parent/child folders)
  • Keep your page organization simple and intuitive

Perfect for websites with many pages that need better organization in the WordPress backend. The plugin works out of the box with no complicated configuration needed.

Features

  • Simple folder creation for pages
  • Hierarchical folder structure support
  • Filter pages by folder in admin
  • Lightweight with no performance impact
  • No conflict with other plugins
  • Works with default WordPress pages
  • Completely free to use
  • No ads or upsells
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘simple-page-folder-organizer’ folder to your wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start creating folders from the “Page Folders” section when editing pages
  4. Filter pages by folder using the dropdown above the pages list
sections.faq:
How do I assign a page to a folder?

When editing a page, you’ll see a “Page Folders” meta box where you can create and assign folders.

Can I have sub-folders?

Yes, the plugin supports hierarchical folders. Just set a parent folder when creating new folders.

Does this affect my frontend pages?

No, this is purely for backend organization. It won’t change anything on your live website.

Can I filter pages by folder?

Yes, use the folder dropdown filter above the pages list in WordPress admin.

Are there any limitations?

This works only with default WordPress pages, not custom post types (unless modified).

Where can I get support?

For any issues, please contact info@come2theweb.com or come2theweb@gmail.com you can reach us from our website as well – https://come2theweb.com
